faqs.question: How to merge PDF files online for free?
faqs.answer: Simply drag and drop your PDF files into our merge tool, arrange them in your desired order by dragging, and click merge. Your combined PDF will be ready to download in seconds.

faqs.question: Is it safe to merge PDFs online?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our PDF merger processes everything in your browser. Your files never leave your device, ensuring complete privacy and security. No data is uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: How many PDF files can I merge at once?
faqs.answer: You can merge unlimited PDF files in a single session. Simply add as many files as you need and arrange them in the order you want them combined.

faqs.question: Can I select specific pages to merge?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our advanced page selection feature lets you choose exactly which pages from each PDF you want to include in your merged document.

faqs.question: Do I need to install any software?
faqs.answer: No software installation required. Our PDF merger works entirely in your web browser. Just open the tool, add your files, and merge them online instantly.

instructionsSection.title: How to Merge PDF Files Online for Free
instructionsSection.description: Combining your documents is simple and takes only a few clicks:

steps.title: Upload Your PDFs
steps.description: Drag and drop the PDF files you want to combine into the tool area, or click the upload button to select them from your device.

steps.title: Arrange Your Order
steps.description: Once uploaded, you can easily drag the files to rearrange them. Ensure the documents are in the exact sequence you want them to appear in the final merged file.

steps.title: Merge Documents
steps.description: Click the "Merge PDF" button. Our engine will process your files in seconds, combining them into a single PDF document while maintaining the original quality.

steps.title: Download Your Result
steps.description: Your final, combined PDF is ready for download immediately. Since there is no server upload, there is no waiting for "processing" or "uploading" bars.
